messages.subject: Orbitrap dataset: Peak Binning
parts:
Hi,

I try to perform a peak binning on Orbitrap dataset to reduce my data for further clustering analysis .

For single pixel  

mse_peaks <- treated_1_pro %>% peakBin(ref=mz(treated_1_proc_ref),  type="height", tolerance=0.02, unit="mz") %>% select(pixel=500) %>% process()

it works perfectly as you can see from the output

An object of class 'MSContinuousImagingExperiment'
  <2052 feature, 1 pixel> imaging dataset
    imageData(1): intensity
    featureData(0):
    pixelData(0):
    metadata(16): spectrum representation ibd binary type ... files name
    processing complete(3): normalize peakPick peakBin
    processing pending(0):
    run(1): treated_1
    raster dimensions: 1 x 1
    coord(2): x = 33..33, y = 13..13
    mass range: 100.4546 to 994.7790 
    centroided: TRUE 

 but when I run for all the data set 

mse_peaks <- treated_1_pro %>% peakBin(ref=mz(treated_1_proc_ref),  type="height", tolerance=0.5, unit="mz") %>% process()

R studio got a fatal error and I have to restart the session.

Did somebody have a similar problem?

Best,
Marco
